scope: Static decoding of selected current official-client AssetBundles. Exact field/node projections; no client execution, combat observation, or runtime XLua override audit. Numerical aggregation is independently recorded in ammo-native.json; these content projections do not establish the formula by themselves.

extraction.method: Decode UnityFS blocks and serialized type trees; parse selected eventToActions SerializedState JSON; retain JSON Pointer and raw event IDs. All 64-bit Unity object identities are decimal strings.
extraction.projectionBoundary: Absent fields are not claims of absence. Event IDs remain serialized integers, without assigning event names from guesswork. Type-tree decoder has incomplete names for some unrelated Unity common strings; retained selected fields have resolved names and matching decoded object lengths.

maxCountActionScan.boundary: A zero count of percentage nodes is limited to this template bundle. It does not imply the native percentage branch is unimplemented or unreachable through other data or XLua.

skillDurationTypeEnum.source: current official global-metadata.dat at native source identity in ammo-native.json
skillDurationTypeEnum.name: Torappu.SkillDurationType
skillDurationTypeEnum.encoding: IL2CPP compressed signed Int32, one-byte records decoded as (u >> 1) ^ -(u & 1), not fixed-width int32.

secondaryCharacterLabelCrosscheck.classification: Existing local third-party mirror of serialized character data, not independently bound to the installed client build. Used only for character labels and talent text/blackboard values; the engine formula is supported independently by native evidence.

confirmedContentObservations: Current official templates contain fixed max-count additions from separate named Buff keys. inside_t_1 uses self_ammo; inside_t_1[active] uses ally_ammo and removes its entry through restoreMaxCount on another event.

Official Inside character Prefab supplies the active ally buff through RandomAuraAbility. Its target validator is MultiTargetValidator AND of laterano group tag and SkillDurationType AMMO(1). The serialized self option is retained as raw 2; no enum label is inferred here.

Official Lemuen character Prefab supplies a separate own buff lemuen_t_2 with a max-count addition add_count. Lemuen skill Prefabs bind CastSkillWithLimitTimes. These configurations support a candidate receiving distinct source contributions; actual simultaneous combat execution and random-target choice were not run.
angel2 is 新约能天使 and lemuen is 蕾缪安 according to the separately classified local character-data label crosscheck; they are not the same operator.
